name: Adaptive Beam Tracing for Volume Caustics
aliases: Real-time volume caustics with adaptive beam tracing
definition: A novel adaptive and scalable algorithm for rendering surface and volume caustics in single-scattering participating media at real-time frame rates. It captures specular surfaces in light-space, traces beams of light instead of single photons, and adaptively generates beams from a grid projected from the light source onto the scene’s surfaces.
